acceptanceCriteria: A changed config is re-validated and applied at the next tick (or via an explicit reload); an invalid config is refused and the old one stays active; tests cover both.
cap: 0 disables a role without removing it; tested.
An optional minAgeSeconds on lane triggers launches a lane role only after the member has stayed in the state that long; tested with a fixed clock.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#645: the dispatcher reads its config only at startup; three restarts on 2026-10-06 only to apply config, each losing worker exit-code observation. A role cannot be disabled (cap must be 1..64). Lane-triggered roles launch the instant a member is QUARANTINED; an LLM sweep role ran 41 sessions and 19 h a day mostly waiting on the scripted sweep.
